text.tspan: Structured hop attention | Operators & tensor flow
Precomputed H / T8,H16,d_a12,hops3 / time Softmax / no mask in source / read bottom to top
B=batch; supplied H:[B,8,16]; r3 hops; attention:[B,3,8].
Source lacks padding masking; each hop normalizes over sequence positions.
Classifier and embedding/LSTM producer are outside the selected boundary.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
